update.officialOnly: Only the official Codex package source is allowed.
update.tooLarge: The package exceeds the size limit.
update.badChecksum: The Codex package checksum does not match. Installation was cancelled.
update.verifierRequired: An integrity check of the tested copy is required.
update.badLock: The update lock file is invalid.
update.lockUnverified: Could not verify the update lock.
update.lock.active: the owner process is running; wait for the operation to finish.
update.lock.stale: the owner process has exited. A leftover recovery lock needs safe recovery; it has not been deleted.
update.lock.unknown: the owner could not be verified; the lock has not been deleted.
update.alreadyRunning: A Codex check or restore is already running.
update.waitForReplies: Wait for the running Codex sessions to finish.

update.originalChecksum: The downloaded package checksum is invalid.
update.probeFailed: The new version did not pass every check. Installation was cancelled.
update.filesChanged: Files changed during verification. Installation was cancelled.
update.sessionStarted: A Codex session started. Retry installation after the reply finishes.
update.busy: Codex is currently working. Installation was postponed.
update.installFailed: Installation did not finish. The saved verified version is available through Restore verified Codex. {message}
update.noRecovery: There is no intact verified recovery package. Run Check and update Codex.
update.restorePostponed: Restore was postponed because the state changed.
update.timeout: The check exceeded its time limit.
update.cancelled: The check was cancelled. The installed version was kept.
update.launchFailed: Could not launch the verification tool.
update.longPath: The temporary path is too long for the VS Code check.
update.binaryMissing: Could not find the VS Code executable for the test window.
update.installUnverified: Could not confirm installation of verified Codex with automatic updates disabled.
update.confirmInstall: Install verified Codex {version}? You will need to reload the window. Wait for the current replies to finish.
update.confirmRestore: Restore verified Codex {version}? You will need to reload the window. Wait for the current replies to finish.
update.confirmCheck: The check downloads the official Codex {version} package (up to 400 MB) and opens a separate VS Code test window for a few minutes. It puts a heavy load on the processor and disk. Start now?
update.macOnly: Update verification needs local VS Code on a Mac with a verified Codex profile for this processor.
update.progressCheck: Checking Codex in a separate window
update.latestUnsupported: Codex {version} has not been verified with tabs yet. It will not be installed. Keeping the compatible version.
update.installed: Codex was installed from the verified VSIX. Reload the window after the current replies finish to apply the changes.
update.canRestore: {message} You can restore the verified version.
update.canRevalidate: {message} A recovery package is saved. Restore will first check it with this version of Codex Tabs in a separate window.
update.recoveryRetained: The previous recovery ({version}) is saved separately because it did not pass verification with this companion. The new recovery has passed its own checks.
